title: Brace (DefenseComponent) and Integrity components
acceptance: Brace 2s/12s cooldown from end/75% rig reduction

result.summary: Brace and integrity components finished to spec. Brace maths is a pure model (Combat/BraceModel.h): 2 s field, 12 s cooldown from the end, 75% rig reduction, frame-rate independent. UDefenseComponent adds OnBraceReady and OnBraceAbsorbedDamage, GetReadiness for the HUD, ResetBrace for retries, and ticks only when needed. UIntegrityComponent binds to the owner's engine damage, broadcasts OnDamaged (applied, prevented, causer), OnIntegrityChanged and a once-only OnDepleted, and adds RestoreCheckpoint (P-04) and IncomingDamageScale (Assisted).
result.verification: Built ETMEditor Win64 Development on UE 5.8.4, zero errors and warnings. 5 new automation tests (ETM.Combat.*) pass in a headless editor, plus the 5 existing ETM.Player tests. Components were tested as standalone objects: no actor, no level, no headset.
result.remaining: bBindToOwnerDamage (routing ApplyDamage on the owning actor into the pool) is compiled but not exercised in a world; check it when the first enemy attack lands (T-0013/T-0014). Activation audio and visual cue is T-0015/T-0019. Assisted damage scale value is not chosen. Branch agent/claude-code-dartonx-pc/t-0011 needs a PR into main.
result.next: Review T-0011. T-0009 (cannon component) and T-0012 (input) are ready once T-0007 is approved in the tracker; T-0013 (enemy base) and T-0018 (objective) open after T-0011 is approved.
